bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (local store), springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs (contacts service: access, fetch, save), springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (SDK), springboard/apps/contacts-desktop (Contacts app), springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs (search index), springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard export)
summary: BifrOSt has a shell-internal local contact store (one flat file, fixed fields, atomic save) that the Contacts app, Search and Share use directly. Apps read and save contacts through the SDK contacts module and the contacts service, behind a per-app access grant. No groups, containers or change history exists. Apps with a contacts read grant get system.contacts.change when the store file changes.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (load, load_checked, save), springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs (contacts service), springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (access, request, fetch, save)
features.note: The store is a shell module (the Contacts app reaches it by crate path, springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs:20). Apps reach it only through the contacts service and the SDK contacts module, behind a per-app grant. The store file itself is not visible to apps.

features.apple: Accessing the contact store; NSContactsUsageDescription; contact access button and picker
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_access.rs, springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs (access, request), springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (access, request, decode_status, decode_picked)
features.note: Four-state model per app: not determined, denied, authorized (every contact) and limited (a picked set, read-only), plus restricted. An app reads its status with access and asks with request, but request never grants. The shell sets grants; the access sheet and Settings row are not built yet. Grants reset on restart.

Fixed fields: name, phone, email, notes, company, address, favorite, and three label indexes. The SDK and the `contacts` service now return labeled multi-values (phones, emails, URLs as label/value/identifier), a birthday and labeled dates from a sidecar file (springboard/src/shell/contactextras.rs); the Contacts app still edits one phone, one email and one address. No relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs, images or nickname. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Multi-values are SDK-side only; verify on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs:LABELS; wired: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/extras.rs (ValueKind, labels from contactstore::LABELS); src/exchange.rs (type_of, label mapping); springboard/ui/src/contact_fetch.rs:LabeledValue
features.note: Fixed English label sets (mobile, home, work, other) indexed by number. No custom labels, no localized label strings. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Wave sprint4/7: LabeledValue (label, value, identifier), DateComponents and label constants (home, work, other, mobile, main) in springboard/ui/src/contact_fetch.rs and the SDK; custom labels are carried as plain text.

The contacts service returns each record with only the keys the app asked for, and fetch takes an optional query over any text of the contact. Not yet: a partial-contact error when a key was not fetched, and Midget testing. Search covers name, phone, email, notes, company and address.

Apps add, update and delete contacts in one save call through the contacts service and the SDK. Full access only: a limited grant is read-only. The whole call applies or none of it does, and the store is rewritten atomically only on success. No per-record change history.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_changes.rs, springboard/ui/src/contact_groups.rs, springboard/ui/src/vcard.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/contact_groups.rs (wired in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs and group_file.rs)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. One flat list with no groups, containers or subgroups. Contacts keeps a lists sidebar in the app, but it has no group data behind it. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. features.apple: Spotlight-style indexing of contacts (no direct CNContact symbol)
features.note: Shell Search returns contacts from the store. Apps index their own content through the SDK quicksearch module, which the contact store does not use.

features.apple: Contact access button, Contact access picker (sample code)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_access.rs (access model, wired in springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs); springboard/ui/src/contact_picker.rs (wired: Add People picker in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs, Picker at line 1063)
features.note: The Contacts app uses the picker model for its Add People flow. No SDK picker lets an app ask the user to choose a contact and receive the result, so that part is still missing. Not yet tested on the VM or Midget.
Errors are std io errors with fixed text (Invalid contact, Contacts file too large, Unknown contacts format). No typed error codes for apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs:Contact.notes (MAX_NOTES 4000); springboard/ui/src/contact_book.rs: image_data, thumbnail_image_data and note keys; vCard PHOTO round trip in contact_vcard.rs. Thumbnail is not serialized.
features.note: Notes are plain text with a 4000-character limit, with no entitlement. No contact photo or thumbnail data.

gaps: Single-valued fields only: one phone, one email, one address. No birthday, dates, relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs or photos.
No access sheet or Settings row for contact access; the shell sets grants, and they reset on restart.
No vCard in the SDK: apps cannot parse or build vCards. Import and export live in the Contacts app (springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/exchange.rs).
Every fetch reads the whole store file (cap 10,000 contacts, 8 MiB file) before the service filters it.
